ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity black pixels (covering the central delta and margins) to high-intensity white pixels (covering lateral lobe surfaces).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized black delta-shaped region extending to the median notch. White lateral lobes feature heavy black mottling and streak-like pixel clusters concentrated along the trailing edges and lower interior quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 50 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations. Notable high-amplitude irregular indentation (tissue loss) on the left lobe (viewer's left) trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer leading edges follow a convex mathematical curve, tapering to sharp, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small circular depressions (pitting) visible on the upper-mid high-intensity white region of the right lobe (viewer's right).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark, unaligned linear rake marks; four primary diagonal lines on the left lobe and several shorter vertical/diagonal lines on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch/missing tissue section on the mid-trailing edge of the left lobe, distinct from the standard serration pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, brush-stroke-like black pigmentation patterns at the transition zones between the white lateral fields and the black central fluke body.
